parameters.query:
-- Drop existing tables in correct order (handle foreign key constraints)
DROP TABLE IF EXISTS complete_dd_reports CASCADE;
DROP TABLE IF EXISTS due_diligence_reports CASCADE;
DROP TABLE IF EXISTS company_data CASCADE;

-- Table for company PDF data (input for subworkflows)
CREATE TABLE company_data (
    id SERIAL PRIMARY KEY,
    company_id VARCHAR(255) UNIQUE NOT NULL,
    company_name VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL,
    folder_id VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL,
    content TEXT NOT NULL,
    processed_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
);

-- Table for AI-generated report sections (output from subworkflows)
CREATE TABLE complete_dd_reports (
    id SERIAL PRIMARY KEY,
    company_id VARCHAR(255) UNIQUE NOT NULL,
    company_name VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL,
    
    -- Section 1: Executive Summary & Key Findings
    executive_summary TEXT,
    
    -- Section 2: Legal Disclaimers & Reliance Limitations  
    legal_disclaimers_reliance_limitations TEXT,
    
    -- Section 3: Methodology & Source Validation Protocols
    methodology_source_validation TEXT,
    
    -- Section 4: Business Overview
    business_overview TEXT,
    
    -- Section 5: Company Overview
    company_overview TEXT,
    
    -- Section 6: Business Model
    business_model TEXT,
    
    -- Section 7: Products & Services
    products_services TEXT,
    
    -- Section 8: Target Market & Competitive Set
    target_market_competitive_set TEXT,
    
    -- Tracking and metadata
    sections_completed INTEGER DEFAULT 0,
    status VARCHAR(100) DEFAULT 'pending_ai_generation',
    created_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
    updated_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
    
    -- Foreign key relationship
    FOREIGN KEY (company_id) REFERENCES company_data(company_id)
);

-- Create indexes for better performance
CREATE INDEX idx_complete_dd_reports_company_id ON complete_dd_reports(company_id);
CREATE INDEX idx_complete_dd_reports_status ON complete_dd_reports(status);
CREATE INDEX idx_company_data_company_id ON company_data(company_id);

SELECT 'Database setup complete - ready for subworkflow integration with all 8 sections' as status;

-- Get ALL AI-generated content from complete_dd_reports table for sections 1-8
-- Return empty result if no AI content exists yet (don't stop workflow)
SELECT 
  COALESCE(r.company_id, '{{ $node["Save Company Data"].json.company_id }}') as company_id,
  COALESCE(r.company_name, '{{ $node["Save Company Data"].json.company_name }}') as company_name,
  r.executive_summary,
  r.legal_disclaimers_reliance_limitations,
  r.methodology_source_validation as section3_content,
  r.business_overview as section4_content,
  r.company_overview as section5_content,
  r.business_model as section6_content,
  r.products_services as section7_content,
  r.target_market_competitive_set as section8_content,
  r.sections_completed,
  COALESCE(r.status, 'pending_ai_generation') as status,
  COALESCE(r.created_at, NOW()) as created_at
FROM (
  SELECT 
    company_id,
    company_name,
    executive_summary,
    legal_disclaimers_reliance_limitations,
    methodology_source_validation,
    business_overview,
    company_overview,
    business_model,
    products_services,
    target_market_competitive_set,
    sections_completed,
    status,
    created_at
  FROM complete_dd_reports 
  WHERE company_id = '{{ $node["Save Company Data"].json.company_id }}'
  ORDER BY updated_at DESC 
  LIMIT 1
) as r
UNION ALL
SELECT 
  '{{ $node["Save Company Data"].json.company_id }}' as company_id,
  '{{ $node["Save Company Data"].json.company_name }}' as company_name,
  NULL as executive_summary,
  NULL as legal_disclaimers_reliance_limitations,
  NULL as section3_content,
  NULL as section4_content,
  NULL as section5_content,
  NULL as section6_content,
  NULL as section7_content,
  NULL as section8_content,
  0 as sections_completed,
  'pending_ai_generation' as status,
  NOW() as created_at
WHERE NOT EXISTS (
  SELECT 1 FROM complete_dd_reports 
  WHERE company_id = '{{ $node["Save Company Data"].json.company_id }}'
)
LIMIT 1;
